datasets.name: Account
datasets.sql:
SELECT   
   ACCOUNT.RowID, ID, kli_id, op_id, acc_no, val_acc, NAME, open_dat, close_dat,
   DECODE (close_dat, NULL, 1, 2) AS status, bal_cn1, bal_cn2, bal_cn3,
   bal_cn4, filial, sim_otcet, tipacc, LIMIT, old_acc_no, pair_acc,
   insider
FROM ACCOUNT
ORDER BY 
   :title

datasets.name: DebetTransactionsData
datasets.sql:
select
  p.ID,
  p.debt as DebitAccID,
  p.dat as OperationDate,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.ammount_c as CreditAmount,
  p.lammount as LAmount,
  ac.acc_no as CreditAccNo,
  p.NAME as Destination
from
  SMART.provarch p,
  SMART.account ac
where
  (p.dat between :StartDate and :EndDate)
  and (p.debt = :AccountID)
  and (ac.id = p.kredit)
order by p.dat

datasets.name: CreditTransactionsData
datasets.sql:
select
  p.ID,
  p.kredit as CreditAccID,
  p.dat as OperationDate,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.ammount_c as CreditAmount,
  p.lammount as LAmount,
  ad.acc_no as DebitAccNo,
  p.NAME as Destination
from
  SMART.provarch p,
  SMART.account ad
where
  (p.kredit = :AccountID)
  and (p.dat between :StartDate and :EndDate)
  and (ad.id = p.debt)
order by p.dat
